The derivative lower bound 21/20 yields geometric tail R=1250000/85766121. Thus Z>=I-R>0 and rho>=(H-R)/(I+R)=170333841/67511439>5/2 on an open interval. value.rationale: This is an exact disproof of a natural published sharp numerical bound for stationary densities of topologically mixing expanding interval maps, not a negative normalization check or a routine recomputation of a density table. The counterexample has a nondegenerate positive-measure violating interval, is structurally robust under perturbations, and exposes the need to distinguish the original sharp ceiling conjecture from the weaker finite-uniform-bound conjecture.
